title: The normalized scalar/pullback comparison respects the four tensor comparisons
statement: For any coefficient systems R,S, a compatible Change a:R→S, a scheme morphism g:U→V, arbitrary representative-normalized tensor models aU,aV,bU,bV over their respective coefficient sheaves, and arbitrary unbounded derived R_V-modules P,Q, the inverse scalarPull comparison is compatible with the scalar tensorators and geometric pullback tensorators. Precisely, starting with pull_S(g)(C_V(P tensor Q)), the route scalarPull^{-1} then C_U(tensorPull_R) then scalarTensor_U equals pull_S(g)(scalarTensor_V) then tensorPull_S then tensor(scalarPull^{-1}_P,scalarPull^{-1}_Q). This is the displayed equality of the attached Lean statement. These left-adjoint data come from [def-pur-integral-compact-support-coefficient-data], and the models are [def-sfb-proetale-tensor-model]. No projection, proper image, flatness of a, boundedness, or completeness is assumed.

source.place: Tags 07A4, 07A6, 0D6D and 0E48; for the open factor also sites-modules.tex Tag 0E8I. Expanded verification of the coefficient-square step of fix-prop-projection-formula.proof.md.

proof.text: Take flat-term K-flat representatives P,Q. Extract the four existing representative normalization equations for the geometric and scalar tensorators. Naturality of the scalar/geometric computation counits normalizes each composite tensorator. Precompose the desired equation with the localized source representative isomorphism and postcompose with the tensor of the composite counits, which are invertible on these representatives. Use the single-complex scalarPull normalization at P,Q and their total tensor. Naturality of the target representative isomorphism reduces the resulting equation to localization of the ordinary signed-total coefficient square; apply that square and cancel the isomorphisms.

For each arbitrary derived input choose a flat-term K-flat resolution and its localized isomorphism. The two routes are natural transformations of bifunctors. Their naturality for the product of the two representative isomorphisms transports the established equality to the arbitrary pair, by cancellation of the source isomorphism.

proof_origin.note: Explicit Lean proof of derived representative transport and objectwise descent. The two outstanding strictly smaller obligations are ordinary signed-total tensor compatibility and single-complex counit normalization.

lean.statement:
theorem scalarPull_tensor_coefficient_coherence
    {R S : Coefficients.{u}} (a : Change R S)
    {U V : Scheme.{u}} (g : U ⟶ V)
    (aU : ProEtaleTensorModel U (R.ring U))
    (aV : ProEtaleTensorModel V (R.ring V))
    (bU : ProEtaleTensorModel U (S.ring U))
    (bV : ProEtaleTensorModel V (S.ring V))
    (P Q : DerivedCategory (pbcModules V (R.ring V))) :
    (scalarPull a g).inv.app (aV.tensor.obj (P, Q)) ≫
      (pbcDerivedExtend (a.map U)).map
        ((proEtaleCanonicalTensorComparison g (R.ring V) (R.ring U)
          (R.pull g) aV aU).hom.app (P, Q)) ≫
      (scalarTensor (a.map U) aU bU).hom.app
        ((pull R g).obj P, (pull R g).obj Q) =
    (pull S g).map ((scalarTensor (a.map V) aV bV).hom.app (P, Q)) ≫
      (proEtaleCanonicalTensorComparison g (S.ring V) (S.ring U)
        (S.pull g) bV bU).hom.app
          ((pbcDerivedExtend (a.map V)).obj P, (pbcDerivedExtend (a.map V)).obj Q) ≫
      bU.tensor.map (Prod.mkHom ((scalarPull a g).inv.app P)
        ((scalarPull a g).inv.app Q))
